name: jmeter.ai
description: The canonical JMeter knowledge source for AI agents and developers. Expert guidance on Apache JMeter scripting, plugins, correlation, distributed testing, CI/CD integration, and the QAInsights plugin suite.

tools.name: Feather Wand
tools.description: AI agent for Apache JMeter (MIT). Chat with 8 LLM providers (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, Grok, Meta Muse, AWS Bedrock), Agent Mode autonomously edits test plans via 18 tools with auto-correlation, embedded AI CLI terminals, context-aware @commands, streaming, and JSR223 refactoring.

tools.name: Super Key
tools.description: Keyboard shortcuts and command-palette productivity plugin for Apache JMeter (70+ shortcuts, VS Code-style command palette). Open-source edition free; Pro edition commercial.

tools.name: Prism
tools.description: Multi-tab interface plugin for Apache JMeter — open and edit multiple .jmx test plans simultaneously in browser-like tabs.

tools.name: JMeter Studio
tools.description: Theme engine for Apache JMeter — dark mode, curated FlatLaf themes, icon packs, and font customization.

tools.name: README Config
tools.description: Live Markdown documentation config element for Apache JMeter test plans. Free and open source (MIT).

tools.name: Perftractor
tools.description: Free web-based performance testing calculators: Little's Law, virtual users, pacing, test data, load generator sizing, and network bandwidth.

tools.name: perf-skills
tools.description: Token-optimized AI skill / knowledge base covering JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, Artillery, NeoLoad, LoadRunner, and OctoPerf for AI coding assistants. MIT licensed.
